examples.name: Default
examples.summary: Single thumb over 0–100 in steps of 1, bound with `v-model` and named with `aria-label`.

examples.name: Ticks
examples.summary: A tick mark under every step. Ticks render only when the range has at most 21 positions.

examples.name: ReferenceValues
examples.summary: Labelled landmarks under the track. `unit` is appended to each label and to the announced value.

examples.name: Disabled
examples.summary: Disabled: skipped by Tab, ignores pointer and keys, and uses the disabled tokens.

examples.name: Invalid
examples.summary: Invalid: the fill and thumb border switch to the danger tokens and aria-invalid is set.
